purpose: Separate policy development evidence from record/text-disjoint confirmatory external evaluation without exposing either split to the A-B-C runtime.

development.role: policy development and regression evidence only

confirmatory.role: one-time external evaluation after policy freeze

integrity_requirements: both benchmark exclusion audits must be complete and pretraining eligible
stable record IDs must be present in both audited candidate corpora
record IDs and normalized text hashes must have zero cross-split overlap
policy fingerprints from both curation reports must match exactly
development or confirmatory metadata and outcomes must not be read by the A-B-C runtime
claim_boundary: A confirmatory-ready report proves source separation and frozen policy identity, not intrinsic text quality or universal downstream improvement.
